components.name: Primary Coral Capsule CTA
components.description: High-contrast obsidian ink on Signal Coral pill linking to BDN survey.
components.html: Express Your Interest
components.css: .ka-btn-coral { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ff5a26; color: #0d1012; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ka-btn-coral:hover { background: #e84b18; } .ka-btn-coral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a26; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.html:

components.css: .ka-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background: rgba(13,16,18,0.92); color: #f8f8f6; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'Onest Variable', sans-serif; } .ka-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; } .ka-num { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ff5a26; color: #0d1012; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ka-links { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ka-links a { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; color: #a8b0b8; text-decoration: none; } .ka-links a.is-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #f8f8f6; } .ka-nav-cta { border-radius: 9999px; background: #ff5a26; color: #0d1012; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Provisional Details Ledger Row
components.description: 1px hairline obsidian ledger row used across dates, rooms (€599/€749), and logistics.
components.html:
Shared twin room (indicative)
€599 per person

Twin room with private bathroom, shared with one other participant. Provisional.
components.css: .ka-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(248,248,246,0.14); padding: 24px 0; background: #0d1012; color: #f8f8f6; font-family: 'Onest Variable', sans-serif; } .ka-ledger-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a8b0b8; } .ka-ledger-val strong { display: block; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ka-ledger-val p { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: #a8b0b8; }

components.name: Villa Scouting Dashed Placeholder
components.description: Transparent placeholder marking pending coworking/villa media until bookings open.
components.html:
Placeholder · Villa Media & Specs PendingScouting

components.css: .ka-placeholder { border: 1px dashed rgba(17,19,21,0.25); border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; padding: 24px; color: #111315; font-family: 'Onest Variable', sans-serif; } .ka-ph-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ka-placeholder p { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #4b5259; }
